description: Take full-page screenshots of websites as PNG or PDF. Configure viewport, wait conditions, scrolling, and element hiding.

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after the page loads before taking the screenshot. Useful for pages with animations or lazy-loaded content.
delay.title: Delay Before Screenshot (ms)

delayAfterScrolling.description: Milliseconds to wait after scrolling to bottom. Only applies when Scroll to Bottom is enabled and Wait for Network Idle After Scroll is disabled.
delayAfterScrolling.title: Delay After Scrolling (ms)

format.description: Screenshot output format. PNG captures a full-page image. PDF generates a printable document.
format.title: Output Format

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. The actor works without proxy for most websites.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

scrollToBottom.description: Scroll to the bottom of the page before taking the screenshot. Triggers lazy-loaded images and infinite scroll content.
scrollToBottom.title: Scroll to Bottom

selectorsToHide.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors of elements to hide before taking the screenshot. Example: '.cookie-banner, #popup, .ads'
selectorsToHide.title: CSS Selectors to Hide

urls.description: List of web page URLs to capture as screenshots.
urls.title: URLs to Screenshot

viewportWidth.description: Browser viewport width in pixels. Height is fixed at 1080px.
viewportWidth.title: Viewport Width (px)

waitUntil.description: When to consider the page loaded before taking the screenshot.
waitUntil.title: Wait Until

waitUntilNetworkIdleAfterScroll.description: After scrolling, wait until no network requests are made for 500ms. Ensures all lazy-loaded content finishes loading. Overrides Delay After Scrolling.
waitUntilNetworkIdleAfterScroll.title: Wait for Network Idle After Scroll

waitUntilNetworkIdleAfterScrollTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for network idle after scrolling. Only applies when Wait for Network Idle After Scroll is enabled.
waitUntilNetworkIdleAfterScrollTimeout.title: Network Idle After Scroll Timeout (ms)

title: Screenshot URL Input
